home.heroTitle: Care that is organised from the first visit to discharge
home.heroText: One system for registration, appointments, consultations, laboratory, pharmacy, billing in Birr, and hospital beds. Every staff member sees only what their role allows.

patients: One record and one MRN for every patient
appointments: Doctor slots, walk-ins and a live queue
opd: Vital signs, notes, diagnoses and orders
billing: Invoices and payments by cash, Telebirr or bank

sec: Role-based access checked on the server
Every action recorded in the audit log
English and Amharic, Ethiopian calendar and Birr
home.footer: Authorised staff only. Sign in with the account given by the hospital administrator.
